hipaaOpenAIEnabled.title: Allow OpenAI mode for this organization
hipaaOpenAIEnabled.description: Set to true only if your organization has an executed OpenAI BAA with Modified Retention and has confirmed endpoint coverage. Treatable does not verify the BAA.

allowedOpenAIOrgIds.title: Allowed OpenAI organization IDs
allowedOpenAIOrgIds.description: OpenAI organization IDs (org-...) whose API keys may be used. Each request is pinned to the matching ID with the OpenAI-Organization header, so keys from other organizations are rejected by OpenAI.
